articles.summary: National Grid Electricity Transmission (NGET) has begun main construction of a new substation near Woolavington in Somerset which will support the creation of around 4,600 local jobs.Once complete, the new 400kV substation will connect the Gravity Smart Campus to the electricity transmission network and provide the infrastructure needed to support growing electricity demand in the region.
articles.title: National Grid starts construction on Somerset substation supporting over 4,500 new jobs

articles.summary: National Grid is launching BackupBattery+, a new residential battery pilot program for income-eligible customers in the Fall River area, in partnership with Haven Energy. The program will provide up to 125 income-eligible households with no-cost home battery systems, which can provide backup power during outages and help reduce strain on the local electric grid during periods of peak demand.
articles.title: National Grid Launches Fall River Area Home Battery Pilot

articles.summary: Customer webinar set for Monday, November 30, with in-person assistance events planned across Massachusetts in DecemberWALTHAM, MA – With winter approaching and a storm expected to affect parts of Massachusetts later this week, National Grid has prepared its electric and gas systems to serve customers through storms and periods of high energy demand, while also connecting customers with programs and resources that can help manage winter energy costs.
articles.title: National Grid Prepares for Winter, Connects Massachusetts Customers with Energy Assistance
